market_name: Greater St. Louis Bi-State Metro (MO-IL) (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: PTF-ST-LOUIS-MARKET-001 bi-state traveler-market bounding box, NOT the St. Louis MO-IL MSA (which reaches Bond, Clinton, Macoupin, Calhoun, Lincoln, Warren and Washington counties, all of Franklin County and southern Jefferson County). The box covers the Missouri core (St. Louis City, all of St. Louis County, the developed eastern half of St. Charles County, northern Jefferson County to Arnold/Imperial, and the Eureka-Pacific I-44 shoulder) plus the Illinois Metro East lodging belt (St. Clair and Madison counties from Columbia IL north to Alton, east to O'Fallon IL / Shiloh / Mascoutah). Corners are chosen so a bounded-radius query can never reach Washington MO, Union MO, Festus/Crystal City, Hillsboro, Waterloo IL, Highland IL, Litchfield IL, Carlyle IL or Ste. Genevieve -- each of which is a separate traveler market that nonetheless sells itself with St. Louis marketing language.
geographic_bounds._boundary_risk: The bounding box is a query fence, not the market. Membership is decided per identity by corridor assignment; a row discovered inside the box but outside every corridor is recorded and dispositioned, never silently kept.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~2 decimal places, roughly 1km) approximate municipal-center reference points from general public geographic knowledge, rounded deliberately to avoid a false impression of survey-grade precision. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries, never property coordinates, and nothing downstream may treat them as a property location.

scope_disclosure: 18 cells covering the Greater St. Louis bi-state traveler market per PTF-ST-LOUIS-MARKET-001. Cells overlap deliberately -- overlap costs a duplicate that deduplication removes, a gap costs a hotel nobody ever sees. The alton-riverbend and metro-east-belleville cells are the two boundary risks: both reach lodging that markets itself as St. Louis while sitting 25-30 road miles out, and every identity discovered in them carries its cell so a boundary decision can be revisited without re-running discovery.
_municipality_note: Municipality names are BARE city names, never suffixed with a state. classify_lodging_scope normalises the candidate's own city field and compares it to this list; 'O'Fallon IL' would never match a record whose city is 'O'Fallon'. The bi-state ambiguity (O'Fallon, Columbia, Troy, Maryville, St. Charles all name a place in both states or far outside the market) is resolved by the bounding box and the corridor assignment, not by decorating a name.
